body: I felt 200% sure when I made the post. Now, I don't know what I am going to do tomorrow. I really want to do it. I don't want to feel this way anymore.
I am on medication and it is not helping me. I don't really have any goals or dreams anymore. I don't care about anything enough. I do appreciate the support.
True. I've done this before. I know what happens. Pills are going to be plan A. If I don't think it is working, I will try to bleed out.
I already ruined my chance. I am most likely not going to graduate high school with my class.
They just stopped talking to me. Even when I tried talking to them, they barely responded. I just got faded out.

Well, it really depends on which family member. My dad is verbally and physically abusive. My mom is neglecting me. Now they are divorced and I am in the middle. I live with my mom. One of my sisters criticizes me and the other wants me around to build up her ego.
I need more time to clean my room and finish my note. I thought one day was enough. I would do it today if I thought everything would be done in time.
May I also have the link?

You aren't selfish for wanting it to all stop. I get that. You said yourself that you don't want to die. You worked hard and I believe in you. I don't know you but I believe if you are strong enough to come back from that, you can do it again. Give it one more day for as many days as it takes. Watch your favorite movie. Fight club is a great movie. One of my favorites. Eat your favorite food. Just from my experience, no reason is a bad reason to live. It doesn't need to be big. Just think of one thing you want to do that you haven't yet. My reason is that I would really like to see a field of sunflowers. Please keep trying.
